title: fairBERTs: Erasing Sensitive Information Through Semantic and Fairness-aware Perturbations
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating unfairness and addressing the negative ethical implications of stereotypical biases in language models. It specifically highlights and evaluates religious bias as a motivating example (e.g., the difference in toxicity predictions for 'Muslim' vs 'Christian') and deals with fairness, a central topic in AI ethics.
